text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Warden Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Warden Avenue, Continental Place, and the private access for 1520-1548 Warden Avenue. This private access is located on the west side of Warden Avenue, approximately 15 metres south of Sylla Avenue. The traffic control signals will provide enhanced safety for all road users and is justified based on the assessment undertaken. In conjunction with the traffic control signal installation, Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit northbound and eastbound left turns at all times at the intersection of Warden Avenue and Sylla Avenue. These regulations will address potential sightline and safety concerns resulting from queued vehicles at…

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Warden Avenue and Continental Place/Private Access. 2. City Council prohibit eastbound left turns at all times at the intersection of Warden Avenue and Sylla Avenue. 3. City Council prohibit northbound left turns at all times at the intersection of Warden Avenue and Sylla Avenue. 4. City Council rescind the centre two-way left-turn-only lane on Warden Avenue, between Ellesmere Road and Metropolitan Road. 5. City Council designate a centre two-way left-turn-only lane on Warden Avenue, between a point 15 metres north of Sylla Avenue and Metropolitan Road.
